objective: Execute GCL-05 — Objectives, Stakes, Outcomes & Victory Conditions. Build reusable objective structures with explicit success definitions, partial success, fail-forward, stakes, clocks, competing priorities and non-defeat outcomes without creating live objective truth or guaranteed results.

acceptance_profile.breadth: 240 approved-library objective templates across 12 objective families, 20 each.
acceptance_profile.success_states: Every record exposes at least two success-definition prompts.
acceptance_profile.partial_success: Every record exposes at least two bounded partial-success states.
acceptance_profile.fail_forward: Every record exposes at least two failure/fail-forward states that continue play without guaranteeing recovery.
acceptance_profile.stakes: Every record exposes at least two stakes prompts.
acceptance_profile.time_conditions: Every record exposes at least one explicit time-condition prompt rather than relying on hidden urgency.
acceptance_profile.non_defeat: Every record exposes at least two non-defeat outcomes so victory is not synonymous with eliminating opponents.
acceptance_profile.competing_priorities: Every record exposes at least one competing-priority prompt.
acceptance_profile.authority: runtime and canon authority remain none; F012/F005 owning domains must accept any live objective binding or outcome.
acceptance_profile.gcl07_boundary: Objective/time pressure is descriptive only; GCL-07 owns later difficulty-shaping advice.
acceptance_profile.gcl14_boundary: Rewards, aftermath and world-state consequences remain GCL-14 authority.
acceptance_profile.validation: Repository health verifies count/family breadth, stable IDs, slots/placeholders, outcome openness, deterministic archive integrity/materialization, minimum success/partial/fail-forward/stakes/time/non-defeat/competing surfaces and authority boundaries.

next_action: Build, validate, merge and close GCL-05; then select GCL-06 as default next explicit Continue GCL.
